title: "Choose ... a spell" — no choice of which spell to counter when 2+ spells are on the chain
expected: Riposte's def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/riposte.ts:17-27) is a `sequence` of a bare `{type:"counter"}` (no target) + `modify-might` targeting a friendly unit. Play-time enumeration in play-spell.ts only offers a per-chain-item choice when the TOP-LEVEL effect is `counter` (play-spell.ts:1186-1207, `else if (spellEffect?.type === "counter")`). For a sequence, collectSequenceTargetSlots (targeting.ts:147-171) skips sub-effects with `target === undefined` (line 159), so the only slot is the friendly-unit descriptor; findSequenceLeadTarget returns it, isCardTarget is true (play-spell.ts:787-798 — checks `spellEffect?.type !== "counter"`, which is "sequence" here), and the isCardTarget branch (line 987) enumerates one Play per friendly unit with no spell parameter. At resolution handle_counter (abilities/effects/counter.ts:47-67) reads boundTargets[0] = the unit id, finds it is not on the chain (boundOnChain false), and falls back to the topmost legal spell — silently countering the most recent spell with no pendingChoice. Matches the observed behavior.
observed: playSpell moves for Riposte only enumerated the friendly-unit target (one move per friendly unit, no spell parameter); no pendingChoice appeared at play or resolution. Engine silently countered the most recent spell (Flurry of Blades -> trash) and gave +1 Might; Right of Conquest stayed on the chain. Card def encodes a bare {type:"counter"} with no target selector.
